page.layout: One printed page, a title page, centred. Faint lines of large and small type run down the middle of the leaf. The oval library stamp at the right edge is left out.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and washed out. The title lines are too faint to read, so each line is marked illegible; their letter counts are estimates.
